title: Evidence causal timeline
description: Objective: implement evidence, artifact, rejection, session-coordination, and causal timeline inspection with cursor provenance. Deliverable: evidence/timeline modules. NOT in scope: altering or upgrading evidence. Hard dependencies: Generated control-room client and Session coordination fabric. Owned paths: apps/control-room/src/evidence/** and apps/control-room/src/timeline/**. Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/control-room test.
definitionOfDone: Every rendered fact links to provenance, cursor, actor/session/effect, and exact digest where applicable.
Rejected commands, cursor gaps, recovery markers, and typed session messages remain visible without becoming authority.
Large timelines paginate and resume without silent gaps.
taskRails: The standalone control room displays daemon truth and nextAllowedCommands; it never derives authority, readiness, or evidence strength.
Every fact is text/icon/color encoded, keyboard accessible, provenance-drillable, and honest under degraded data.
IDE adapters remain thin optional launch/discover/embed shells with no product logic. Keep modules below 400 lines; explicit owned paths only.
